hypotheses.title: Reusable generated tools preserve online-build gains
hypotheses.primary_label: Tools built during learning still work when reused later.

sections.heading: Definition and result
sections.note: Each frozen run receives a copy of the registry born in its paired online-build run. Tool generation and candidate repair are disabled.

hypotheses.claim_label: SAGE is not just solving tasks while it generates tools. The tools it creates remain useful when reused later from a frozen registry.
hypotheses.evidence_label: Compares each online-build run with a paired frozen-registry run where generation and repair are disabled.

hypotheses.title: SAGE improves task-completion accuracy over baseline
hypotheses.primary_label: Across matched tasks, SAGE completed more tasks correctly.
hypotheses.claim_label: Across the full benchmark, SAGE completes more tasks than the same LLM agent without autonomous tool generation.
hypotheses.evidence_label: Compares matched baseline and SAGE outcomes for the same task order across all complete replications.

hypotheses.title: Generated tools account for the accuracy gain
hypotheses.primary_label: Lift is measured only where SAGE naturally called generated tools.

sections.heading: Definition and result

rows.label: Subset
rows.value: matched tasks with at least one recorded generated-tool call

sections.note: Diagnostic force-call variables must be absent for these calls to count as natural selection evidence.

hypotheses.claim_label: The strongest gains occur on tasks where SAGE naturally selects and calls a tool it generated.
hypotheses.evidence_label: Uses only generated-tool-called tasks, with force-call diagnostics, scenario-name routing, and synthetic bridge completions disabled.

sections.heading: Canonical/reference score
sections.note: Outcome/task completion is the primary measure. Canonical score is retained as a secondary ToolSandbox benchmark measure.

sections.heading: Replication sensitivity
sections.note: The run-cluster sensitivity treats each independently generated registry as the unit of replication.

sections.heading: Configuration and incident audit
sections.note: A configuration violation is counted when a completed online-build run does not preserve the claim-grade safeguards.
